question: Who won the Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize 2019 for Literature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rana Dasgupta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rana Dasgupta** won the Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize 2019 for Literature.
 
• The prize recognizes outstanding literary works and is named after the renowned Indian poet and Nobel laureate, Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• Rana Dasgupta is a celebrated author known for his works that explore themes of globalization, cultural identity, and the human condition.
 
• The award highlights the importance of literature in fostering cultural understanding and appreciation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize was established to honor the legacy of Rabindranath Tagore and to encourage contemporary writers to contribute to literature and culture.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for his work "Gitanjali."
 
• The prize includes a monetary award, a Tagore statuette, and a certificate of recognition.
 
• The award aims to promote global harmony and peace through the power of literature.
